settings.captureExceptionsHelp: Sends uncaught errors and rejected promises as $exception, at most 10 per minute per page load. Error messages can include what the page was showing, so check that before turning this on. Off by default.
settings.webVitalsHelp: Sends LCP, CLS, INP and FCP once per page load as $web_vitals. Off by default.

surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.description: Ask visitors a question on your site and read the answers here.
surveys.name: Name
surveys.emptyBody: Create a survey, start it, and it appears on the pages you choose. Sites only load surveys while one is running.
surveys.deleteBody: The survey stops showing right away. Answers already received stay as events in Activity.
surveys.starterQuestion: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend?

editor.presentationPopoverHelp: The snippet shows it in a corner of the page. In-app links and email surveys are not available.
editor.presentationApiHelp: Nothing appears on its own. You show it with your own UI and send the answers. See the example below.
editor.choicesHelp: One per line, at least 2 and up to {max}.
editor.atLeastOne: A survey needs at least one question
editor.maxQuestions: A survey can have up to {max} questions.
editor.editLiveNote: If you change a question after people answered, past answers that no longer fit it are left out of the results.
editor.thankYouHelp: Shown for a few seconds after sending. Leave it empty to close right away.
editor.urlContainsHelp: Leave it empty to show it on every page.
editor.flag: Only with this feature flag on
editor.flagHelp: Checked on our server for each person.
editor.flagEmpty: This project has no feature flags yet.
editor.personFilterHelp: Checked on our server against the properties saved for the person. Someone we have no properties for only matches conditions such as "is not set".
editor.showOnceHelp: Remembered in the visitor's browser. If this is off, it can come back in a later session.
editor.sampling: Share of people who see it (%)
editor.samplingHelp: The same person always falls on the same side.
editor.datesHelp: Optional, in the project's time zone. Running surveys only appear between these dates.
editor.apiBody: zs.getSurveys returns the surveys that apply to this person, API ones included. You show the question and send the answer with the same events a popover sends.
editor.apiCurl: Or send the answer from anywhere over HTTP:
editor.previewApi: API surveys have no preview because your own UI shows them.
editor.invalidQuestion: Question {n} is not complete. Check its text and that its choices are at least 2 and not repeated.
editor.invalidDates: The end date has to be after the start date.
editor.invalidForm: Something in the survey is not valid. Check the required fields.
editor.endPassed: This survey is set to running, but its end date has passed. Change or clear the end date for it to show again.

results.exportEmpty: There are no responses to export in this period
results.error: We couldn't load the results. Try again.
results.clientNote: Answers come from visitors' browsers. Only values that fit each question are counted, and text is shown as plain text.
results.truncated: This period has many responses, so the questions below use the most recent 20,000.
results.emptyBody: Answers appear here within seconds of someone sending the survey. Try a longer date range, or start the survey if it is not running.
results.invalid: {count, plural, one {# ignored because it didn't fit the question} other {# ignored because they didn't fit the question}}
results.npsBreakdown: Promoters (9 to 10): {promoters}. Passives (7 to 8): {passives}. Detractors (1 to 6): {detractors}.
results.noAnswers: No text answers in this period.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Errors from your site, grouped when they have the same cause.
errors.captureOff: Automatic capture is off for this project. Errors sent with zs.captureException or over the API still appear here.
errors.captureOffMember: Automatic capture is off for this project. An admin can turn it on in Settings.
errors.error: We couldn't load the errors. Try again.
errors.emptyBody: Turn on capture in Settings, or call zs.captureException(err) from your code, and errors show up here within seconds.
errors.sparkLabel: {count, plural, one {# occurrence in the period} other {# occurrences in the period}}
errors.truncated: Showing the first 100. Search or filter to narrow it down.
errors.regressionHelp: It was resolved and happened again.
errors.assigneeHelp: The assignee gets a notification if a resolved error comes back. That check runs every hour.
errors.saveError: We couldn't save that. Try again.
errors.chartSummary: {count, plural, one {# occurrence in the period} other {# occurrences in the period}}
errors.noStack: This error arrived without a stack trace.
errors.sourceMapsNote: File names and lines are what the browser reported. Source maps are not supported, so minified code stays minified.

llm.title: LLM
llm.description: Calls to language models that you report as $ai_generation events.
llm.error: We couldn't load this. Try again.
llm.emptyTitle: No LLM calls in this period
llm.emptyBody: Send one $ai_generation event for each call to a model, using the same property names as PostHog.
llm.exampleBody: From your server, with the project's secret key. Create the key in Settings.
llm.exampleBrowser: Or from the browser with the snippet (public key {key}):
llm.noWrappers: There are no SDK wrappers for model clients: your code sends the event after each call.
llm.reportedNote: These values are reported by your own code and are not checked against your provider. Negative numbers count as 0 and very large ones are capped.
llm.truncated: This period has many calls, so these numbers use the most recent 50,000.
llm.chartSummary: {calls, plural, one {# call in the period} other {# calls in the period}}
llm.noTraces: No generations in this period have a $ai_trace_id.

web.noPrevious: No data in the previous period
web.filterHint: Click a row to filter the whole page by it.
web.noDataFiltered: No pageviews with these filters in this period. Remove a filter or try a longer range.
web.noDataPeriod: No pageviews in this period. Your snippet has sent pageviews before, so try a longer range.
web.liveNow: {count, plural, one {{formatted} visitor now} other {{formatted} visitors now}}
web.vitalsDesc: How fast your pages feel for real visitors. p75 means 3 out of 4 visits were at this value or better.
web.vitalsOff: Web vitals are off for this project. Turn them on in Settings to start measuring.
web.vitalsOffMember: Web vitals are off for this project. An admin can turn them on in Settings.
web.vitalsError: We couldn't load web vitals. Try again.
web.vitalsEmpty: No measurements in this period yet. A visit is measured when the visitor leaves the page.
web.vitalsTruncated: This period has many measurements, so these numbers use the most recent 20,000.
web.vitalsThresholds: Good is up to 2.5 s for LCP, 200 ms for INP, 0.1 for CLS and 1.8 s for FCP. Poor is over 4 s, 500 ms, 0.25 and 3 s. INP here is the slowest interaction of the visit.

metrics.LCP: Largest Contentful Paint: when the main content appeared
metrics.INP: Interaction to Next Paint: how fast the page answered a click or key
metrics.CLS: Cumulative Layout Shift: how much the layout jumped
metrics.FCP: First Contentful Paint: when something first appeared
